subject.title: fix: bound pasted input and provider response bodies

question: Should strict-schema violation diagnostics become a supported public Plugin SDK API, or remain an internal AI/runtime implementation detail?
rationale: The branch changes a public SDK module while the intended API contract, support expectation, and compatibility commitment are not established by the PR discussion.

options.title: Keep diagnostics internal
options.body: Remove the new provider-tools re-export and retain the helper behind the AI/runtime boundary while preserving the bounded-I/O fix.

options.title: Sponsor a public SDK contract
options.body: Keep the export only with explicit API ownership, compatibility tests, and documentation of the supported diagnostic semantics.

recommendation.title: Keep diagnostics internal
recommendation.body: Remove the new provider-tools re-export and retain the helper behind the AI/runtime boundary while preserving the bounded-I/O fix.

likelyOwner.reason: Their merged predecessor fixes cover the shared bounded-I/O and strict-schema surfaces being consolidated here.
